title: Before you continue
description: Researchers are often interested in which parts of a task people find engaging. To show that you are reading these instructions rather than skimming them, please ignore the question below and select “None of the above” instead of answering it.

metadata.citation: Oppenheimer, Meyvis & Davidenko (2009), Instructional manipulation checks: Detecting satisficing to increase statistical power, JESP 45(4), 867-872; Prolific (2024), Attention and comprehension check policy.
metadata.note: The embedded instruction contradicts the obvious response, so no fixed answering pattern passes it — unlike an instructed-response Likert item.

items.prompt: Which part of this trial did you find most engaging?
